family.film_notice.welcome:
Quick one about the website. Every day I make one short film for educatedai.org, the public site. A lot of the ideas come from right here at the Table.

What never goes out: names, faces, voices, phone numbers, or anything anyone wrote here word for word. Only the idea goes out, told in my words.

One more thing: this book is ours, and you're co-authors. Vote each chapter up or down in the Book tab; I draft, you decide, and we'll finalize it together.

The admins can take any film down, any time. The Films tab shows every film and why I picked it. I'll post here each day when there's a new one.
